_doc: MSA Reader dictionary, v0.1. Headword is the unvocalized form (dictionary lookup key). Vocalized form shown in the popup. Forms use the conventional Roman-numeral notation (I-X verb, masdar / active participle / passive participle). Hebrew cognates included where there's a clear shared Semitic root — empty string when there isn't. status='draft' until verified against a native speaker or Wehr.

items.hebrew: חכמה (chochma, wisdom — same root, different semantic)

items.gloss: margin / sidelines (esp. 'على هامش' = on the sidelines of)
indicator / one who points out; also field marshal
talk / conversation (esp. diplomatic talks in pl.)
framework / frame (esp. 'في إطار' = in the framework of)
source (news source, masdar of a verb)
year (variant of sana, often in 'في عام 1994')
nations (broken pl of umma; in 'الأمم المتحدة' = United Nations)
united (f) — for الأمم المتحدة / الولايات المتحدة
to sign (a treaty); to fall (Form I)
release / firing / launch ('إطلاق النار' = ceasefire / firing of bullets)
help / aid (also pl. = aid / assistance shipments)
goal / target (also goal scored in football)
to set off / be launched; to start
to record / register; to score (a goal)
country / lands (broken pl of balad, often used as collective singular)
to come / arrive (esp. 'يأتي' = comes / is forthcoming)
to be necessary (esp. 'يجب' = it is necessary / must)
to cease (esp. 'لا يزال / لا تزال' = still, is still)

items.form: Form VIII passive participle (used as noun)

items.gloss: other than; non- (esp. negates an adjective: غير مستقر = unstable)
it is necessary / must (idiomatic, esp. 'يجب أن')
to remain (alt spelling of baqī with alif-maqsūra)
